title: Chapter 191 A Late-Stage Immortal Emperor
content:
Chapter 191 A Late-Stage Immortal Emperor

At this time, in the void.

"Mingsheng, step down first."

An illusory voice sounded from Mingsheng's ear.

After hearing this, Mingsheng looked grim, but he still stepped down.

When everyone saw Mingsheng leave, they immediately became more respectful of the strength of the deserted city.

"It seems that this deserted city also has the strength of a special force."

"But it's a bit strange."

In the teahouse of the deserted city, two old men were drinking tea while watching what was happening in the city.

"Oh? What's strange?"

An old man took a sip of tea and asked in a calm voice.

"Didn't you find that no matter the six major forces in the Wood Immortal Realm or the special forces that have been hidden above them, they all have one thing in common."

Hearing this, the other old man's expression gradually became solemn.

"Go on."

"The common point is that they will not be too ostentatious."

Hearing this, the two of them fell silent at the same time.

Yes, in the entire Wood Immortal Realm, after so many years, there will always be some forces that rise.

But those forces were either wiped out on the road to rise, or stopped halfway and then developed steadily.

Look at this deserted city again.

It has been developing wildly and unrestrainedly from beginning to end, and it simply does not take any force into consideration.

Is this because the newborn calf is not afraid of the tiger or there is another reason.

"Haha, things are getting more and more interesting."

One of the white-browed old men suddenly laughed happily.

Another long-haired old man also nodded slightly.

"The woman named Crazy Emperor is not the owner of this city. The city lord is someone else."

"Hahaha, in this case, I really want to know what kind of person the city lord of this deserted city is."

The two looked at each other and decided to stay in this deserted city temporarily. The purpose is self-evident.

Outside the deserted city, in a small obscure space.

Several figures with deep breaths are standing quietly here.

If outsiders notice this, they will be shocked.

Open up space!

This can only be done in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor.

Obviously, there are strong men in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor realm here.

"How much do you think that guy has recovered now?"

One of the figures suddenly spoke.

"At most 30%."

"30%?"

Everyone looked at one person with doubt in their eyes.

The person who spoke was an old man who looked as if he would die in the next second.

And the old man was also the oldest among the people present.

"Old Senior Fang, among all the people present, only you know her best. Has the Mad Emperor really only recovered 30% of his strength?"

The old man was a strong man from the same era as the Mad Emperor.

However, they were only from the same era. At that time, he could only look up at the Mad Emperor.

And the battle between the Mad Emperor and the nine Immortal Emperors was also deeply engraved in his heart.

Even now, it is incredible to think about it.

Time flies.

There are basically very few strong men of the same generation, and he has become an ancestor of his own power, laughing at the world.

But now, the Mad Emperor has reappeared in the world, threatening the interests of the forces.

As the ancestor, he naturally has to come forward.

Although Wan Feng only made a move just now, and it was extremely obscure, he could still see at a glance that the Mad Emperor was just pretending.

"I am sure that it is 30%. As long as we are willing to make a move together, the Mad Emperor will definitely die."

"Including this deserted city."

Of course, if he is wrong, then he didn't say it.

Everyone around nodded when they heard it.

"Okay, since Senior Fang dares to say so, let's give it a try."

"Could it be that with so many of us, can we still be killed by one person?"

Then, everyone stopped hesitating.

Delay will lead to changes.

Swish!

The space cracked, and everyone went directly to the direction of the deserted city.

This time, the Mad Emperor must be killed, and the deserted city must also be strangled in the cradle.

At the same time, two strange figures suddenly appeared above the deserted city.

"I didn't expect that Wan Feng would be so quick to do things."

Looking at the appearance of the deserted city below, although it was not as perfect as he imagined, it was already very good.

The whole deserted city was highlighted by one word.

Big.

It almost had the capacity to accommodate the entire fairyland.

When Yan Lingyun heard Lu Daosheng's words, her expression was shocked, "Wan Feng, is she, is she still in the fairyland?"

That was her apprentice, and the only one.

How could she forget.

However, when she was forced to leave the fairyland, Wan Feng had already become the top powerhouse in the entire fairyland. After so long, Wan Feng should be able to leave this world no matter how much he slacked off.

Yan Lingyun looked puzzled.

Could something have happened at that time?

Obviously, Yan Lingyun was not clear about Wan Feng's sealing.

At this time, Lu Daosheng was about to explain, but a figure soared into the sky from the deserted city and suddenly came towards the two of them.

Seeing the person coming, Yan Lingyun's expression gradually softened.

"Master, Master, it's really you."

Wan Feng looked at Yan Lingyun in front of him, his eyes suddenly turned red, and tears began to flow continuously.

"Master, I knew you would come back."

"Disciple Wan Feng, I greet Master!"

With a bang.

Wan Feng knelt down directly from the void towards Yan Lingyun.

The entire deserted city fell silent at this moment.

The invincible Lord Wan actually knelt down.

Master?

Below, Xun Heng stood up upon hearing the sound and instantly revived with full health.

"Ahaha, who else, who else!!"

In the void, Yan Lingyun also had a complicated expression.

It seems that his apprentice has suffered a lot of grievances over the years.

Just about to speak.

A roar suddenly came from a distance.

"Crazy Emperor, your death is coming!"

Boom!

The terrifying pressure swept across the entire deserted city like the end of the world.

At this moment, dark clouds covered the deserted city, and everyone in the deserted city was uneasy.

Another powerful enemy!

Tsk!

The next moment, in the horrified eyes of everyone, the void suddenly cracked, and six terrifying figures walked out of the space crack slowly with the breath of the Immortal Emperor.

A powerful person in the late Immortal Emperor realm!

Seeing this scene, countless practitioners were shocked.

Is this a show of force to start a war in the Immortal Realm?

The leader of the six people is the leader of the Mu Ling Sect, one of the special forces in the Mu Immortal Realm.

A powerful person at the seventh level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"Crazy Emperor, you caused my Mu Ling Sect's ancestor to be seriously injured back then. Today, I will kill you here and avenge my ancestor!"

The leader of the Mu Ling Sect spoke coldly with murderous intent.

At this time, the six people were slightly stunned, only because Wan Feng was still kneeling in the void.

"Who are you two?"

At this moment, everyone noticed the two people in front of Wan Feng.

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun.

There was no leakage of their aura.

Not simple.

Everyone's expression suddenly became solemn.

And that old man Fang began to slowly retreat backwards imperceptibly.

"Xiao Feng, you get up first."

"Yes, Master."
